name: automagik-workspace
description: One Automagik workspace in its own virtual machine (Debian 13 cloud image; 2 CPUs, 4GiB, 20GiB): the Automagik server and its gate (one image, by digest) and, as settings.reach says, a Cloudflare Tunnel connector (cloudflared 2026.10.7) or a tailnet node (Tailscale 1.104.4), sharing one loopback. Set the settings in a copy of this template. Created stopped: set TUNNEL_TOKEN or TAILSCALE_AUTHKEY, then instance_start.
